What geotechnical rules apply to bluff properties on English Bluff Road?

Lots perched along the western bluff edge fall within the City of Delta English Bluff Geotechnical Development Permit Area. Any major addition, tree removal, drainage alteration, or new home construction requires a site-specific slope-stability and crest-setback report from a qualified geotechnical engineer.
What Flood Construction Levels apply to Boundary Beach and Beach Grove waterfront homes?

Beachfront and low-lying coastal parcels along Boundary Bay sit within designated coastal floodplain zones and must meet City of Delta Flood Construction Level (FCL) elevation requirements and seawall/wave-effect engineering standards.
Are homes over $1.8M in Tsawwassen freehold or leasehold?
Almost all detached homes over $1.8M in English Bluff, Cliff Drive, Central, Pebble Hill, Beach Grove, and Boundary Beach are fee-simple freehold title, whereas properties north of 28 Avenue in
are 99-year prepaid Tsawwassen First Nation leasehold.
How is BC Property Transfer Tax calculated on Tsawwassen homes over $2M and $3M?

British Columbia Property Transfer Tax is 1% on the first $200,000, 2% on the portion from $200,000 to $2,000,000, 3% on the portion from $2,000,000 to $3,000,000, and 5% on the residential value above $3,000,000.
Which schools serve English Bluff, Pebble Hill, and Beach Grove?

English Bluff Elementary (IB Primary Years Programme), Pebble Hill Elementary, and Beach Grove Elementary all feed into South Delta Secondary School (SD37), and private K–12 IB school Southpointe Academy is located right at 56 Street and 18 Avenue.
